proposal.reason: Main functional change is CI job execution reliability: .github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml adds a new step `Log in to the distribution registry` using docker/login-action@v3 with RELEASE_USERNAME/RELEASE_TOKEN before `Pull the distribution image`, changing workflow runtime authentication behavior for each build matrix row so pulls succeed on clean runners. This is owned by ci (workflow execution/runners/environment), and no separate module shows an independent contract or policy change requiring secondary classification.
